profile.visual_desc: Pale green mechanical humanoid with bulky shoulders, digitigrade legs, and dark blue accents. Features a blue loincloth and a small head with a red sensor.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a grey metallic helm. A black T-shaped visor contains a thin, horizontal red glowing eye line. Expressionless and robotic.
profile.weapon_desc: Integrated right-arm energy cannon with dark blue petal-shaped fins.
profile.step1_ready: Stance facing down-right with the right arm-cannon pointed forward and legs braced.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight back and rotates torso slightly, leveling the arm-mounted weapon for a discharge.
profile.step3_impact: Discharges a large, wide cone of bright yellow energy from the arm-cannon muzzle toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the forward leaning pose as the yellow energy fades into jagged sparks and dissipates.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The conical yellow energy blast originates from the arm-cannon muzzle and projects in a straight diagonal line toward the target area.

evaluation.diagnosis: Windup frames F1/F3 deviate from reference perspective. VFX alignment and firing sequence are consistent.
